fields.description: C-stage move triggered by this disposition. Leave blank to preserve C-stage (engagement-only dispositions like Junk). Auto-applied only when the Lead is gated as retry-active (status C0 or lead_status Cold-Unresponsive/Reactivated).
fields.label: Next C-Stage

fields.description: If set, picking this disposition flips the linked Lead's lead_status (engagement) to this value. Use together with or instead of Next C-Stage. Junk → Archived is the canonical engagement-only flow.
fields.label: Next Lead Status

fields.description: Auto-applied as the lead's lost_reason when this disposition triggers a move to a type=Lost C-stage (C6). Bypasses the partial-state where validate_lost_reason rejects the auto-move. Do NOT set to 'Other' — that reason additionally requires lost_notes, which the script does not populate, and the auto-move will fail.
fields.label: Default Lost Reason

fields.description: Block Call Log save when this disposition is chosen and scheduled_callback_at is empty.
fields.label: Requires Callback Datetime

fields.description: Block Call Log save when this disposition is chosen and the linked Lead has no custom_fabricator_routing_reason.
fields.label: Requires Fabricator Routing Reason

fields.description: Block Call Log save when this disposition is chosen and the linked Lead has no lost_reason (and no lost_notes when reason is Other).
fields.label: Requires Lost Reason
